sportySharedSecret.label: SportyPlus shared secret
sportySharedSecret.helpText: Sent as X-Sporty-Secret on pairing/heartbeat callbacks and required on /external/publish. Must match SOCIAL_REDDIT (services.devvit.shared_secret) in the SportyPlus backend.

sportyApiBase.label: SportyPlus API base URL
sportyApiBase.helpText: Base URL the app calls back to. Use https://api.staging.sporty.plus for playtest.

sportyPairingCode.label: SportyPlus pairing code
sportyPairingCode.helpText: Paste the code shown in your club's SportyPlus admin → Social → Connect Reddit. Links this subreddit to your club so announcements can be published here.

items.label: SportyPlus: link status
items.description: Re-send this subreddit's pairing code to SportyPlus and show the link status.
